perks.name: Agile Bowstring
perks.desc:
Durable yet light bowstring.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Tactile String
perks.desc:
Stable, high-friction bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Elastic String
perks.desc:
Excellent snapback.
  •  Decreases accuracy
  •  Faster draw time
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Flexible String
perks.desc:
Light and easy to draw.
  •  Slightly faster draw time
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: High Tension String
perks.desc:
Tightly strung bow.
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly slower draw time
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Natural String
perks.desc:
Simple balanced string.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Polymer String
perks.desc:
Unbreakable bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly faster draw time

perks.name: Carbon Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Light and stable shaft material. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Compact Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Thinner arrows to increase nocking speed and weapon handling.
  •  Increases handling speed 
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Fiberglass Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Heavy and consistent. 
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Helical Fletching
perks.desc:
Aerodynamic and light. 
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Natural Fletching
perks.desc:
Feather-light with good control.
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Greatly increases stability

perks.name: Straight Fletching
perks.desc:
Modern fletching for straight paths. 
  •  Increases accuracy

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.desc: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Archer's Gambit
perks.desc: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw-speed bonus for a short duration.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.desc: Arrows explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.desc: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Gun and Run
perks.desc: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.
